verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an identity provider, since buyers often compare SaaS IdPs against self-hostable ones, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of Okta's core identity platform. The open-source MCP server is a peripheral integration, not the core product. A community user asking for an alternative they can 'run out-of-the box on my own servers' suggests Okta is cloud-only.
